notes: A subject first subscribes actively to one adapter-selected application interaction and passively to the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation interaction from the adapter-supplied IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. After a requester confirms both subscription states through HLArequestSubscriptions, the subject invokes the standard class-scoped unsubscribeInteractionClass service for only the passive MIM class. A fresh query must list only the active application interaction. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM content, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider, application FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, application interaction name, and update-rate designator remain adapter supplied. No vendor API, private headers, or DDM regions are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, bool active = true) = 0
virtual void unsubscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass) = 0
